ctx.x: Well, so it seems that he and Gene/Bullard had a little trouble and this Fia got excited and said, (verbally demonstrating) you want to fight me, you fight me, he grabs Gene -- (verbally demonstrating) -- and had them teeth posed -- Gene cut out and said I don't want to bother with you, you ain't nothing but a savage, I don't want to bother with you. He said come brother, come brother, let's talk to your savage brother, come. Oh, no. The savage -- -- and that was that scene.
Now, another scene -- you know the Corsican, he is somewhat like the Sicilian -- they are the same people only a volcano cut the mountain open and they speak the same
